title: Recruitment
intro: Select the tags from your recruitment slot to compare combinations of 1–3 tags and find operators missing from your Box.
boxHint: Import or select your operators to see ownership. Sample Box data is excluded.
tagCount: {count}/5 tags selected; each combination uses up to 3.
tagLimit: {count}/5 tags selected. Deselect a tag to choose another.
rules: Results assume the listed tags survive; they are not draw probabilities. Ordinary tags may drop. 1★ operators are excluded from 4 hours, 2★ from 7:40. 6★ operators require Top Operator.
robotHint: Robots cannot appear at this duration. Select 3:50 to see 1★ combinations.
starterHint: Starter-tag 2★ operators cannot appear at this duration. Select 3:50 or 4:00.
seniorHint: Use 9:00 with Senior Operator or Top Operator to prevent the applicable rare tag from dropping.
empty: Select the tags in your recruitment slot to see available combinations.
filteredEmpty: No combinations match these filters. Try clearing the result filters.
noMatches: No operators match these tags and duration. Try changing the duration or tags.
dataNote: Uses a pinned CN recruitment pool. Ownership reflects your current Box. Check the pool after game updates.
